description: This file defines a simple in-memory cache module with TTL (Time-To-Live) functionality for client-side memoization in a React project. It provides functions to create caches, retrieve, set, check existence, and clear cache entries, along with a shared singleton cache instance.

methods.name: createMemoryCache(defaultTtlMs = 5 * 60 * 1000)
methods.description: Creates a cache object with get, set, has, and clear methods, with entries expiring after a specified TTL in milliseconds.

methods.name: getAppCache()
methods.description: Returns a shared singleton cache instance for cross-component caching.
